javascript.title: What the heck is the event loop anyway?
javascript.speaker: Philip Roberts
javascript.keyTakeaway: How the V8 call stack, browser Web APIs, task queue, microtask queue, and event loop interact to deliver non-blocking asynchronous execution.

rust.title: Rust: Memory Safety Without Garbage Collection
rust.speaker: Aaron Turon
rust.keyTakeaway: How ownership, borrowing, and lifetime semantics eliminate data races and memory leaks at compile time with zero runtime cost.

go.title: Concurrency is not Parallelism
go.speaker: Rob Pike
go.keyTakeaway: How goroutines and channels compose concurrent programs via CSP (Communicating Sequential Processes) rather than shared-memory threads.

python.title: Transforming Code into Beautiful, Idiomatic Python
python.speaker: Raymond Hettinger
python.keyTakeaway: Mastering the Python data model: dunder methods, iterators, generators, and dictionary hashing internals.

cpp.title: CppCon 2014: Mike Acton "Data-Oriented Design and C++"
cpp.speaker: Mike Acton
cpp.keyTakeaway: Software is data transformation. Hardware latency is governed by cache line transfers and memory layout, not abstract hierarchies.

c.title: CppCon 2017: Matt Godbolt "What Has My Compiler Done for Me Lately?"
c.speaker: Matt Godbolt
c.keyTakeaway: How C lowers directly into CPU registers, stack frames, and instruction pipeline scheduling.

typescript.title: Anders Hejlsberg on TypeScript 2.0 & Type Systems
typescript.speaker: Anders Hejlsberg
typescript.keyTakeaway: Why TypeScript opted for a structural type system with pragmatic erasure, control-flow analysis, and union types.
